expected.title: How To Learn Trigonometry Intuitively
expected.description: Apresenta explicação intuitiva de trigonometria; candidato para Trigonometria.
expected.editorial_note: Individually reviewed 2026-10-08 as an optional English-language intuition supplement for trigonometry. The article explains six trig functions through dome/wall/ceiling analogies, ratios, selected identities, inverse functions and worked examples, but is not a complete course or practice bank: quadrants, periodicity, graphs, radians and full function domains are not systematically covered. 'Percentages' is an analogy for ratios, not a bounded percentage claim; tangent/secant can exceed 1 and sine/cosine can be negative. Some diagrams have short labels and video/calculator embeds were not verified for keyboard, captions or screen-reader use. Basic page inspection only, no WCAG audit. Rights remain link_only under the provider's unversioned CC BY-NC-SA statement; no content copied.
